title: Tiny, cute red car
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- shadow/glow under car -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='34' ry='6' fill='#5a1a1a'/>
  <!-- car body -->
  <rect x='16' y='48' width='68' height='24' rx='9' fill='#e8322a'/>
  <!-- lighter top edge -->
  <rect x='16' y='48' width='68' height='6' rx='6' fill='#ff6b5e'/>
  <!-- cabin / windows area -->
  <path d='M34 48 L40 34 Q41 32 44 32 L62 32 Q65 32 66 34 L72 48 Z' fill='#ff5a4d'/>
  <!-- window glass -->
  <path d='M38 46 L43 35 Q44 34 46 34 L59 34 Q61 34 62 35 L67 46 Z' fill='#9fe8ff'/>
  <!-- window shine -->
  <path d='M41 44 L45 37 L50 37 L48 44 Z' fill='#e6faff'/>
  <!-- tiny mirror -->
  <rect x='32' y='45' width='4' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ffb3aa'/>
  <!-- headlight -->
  <rect x='70' y='53' width='9' height='7' rx='3' fill='#ffe66b'/>
  <!-- tail light -->
  <rect x='19' y='53' width='7' height='6' rx='2.5' fill='#ffb84d'/>
  <!-- door line -->
  <rect x='50' y='52' width='2' height='16' rx='1' fill='#c22420'/>
  <!-- handle -->
  <rect x='54' y='56' width='6' height='2.5' rx='1.2' fill='#ff8a80'/>
  <!-- wheels -->
  <circle cx='31' cy='73' r='9' fill='#3a2f55'/>
  <circle cx='31' cy='73' r='4' fill='#c8b8ff'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='73' r='9' fill='#3a2f55'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='73' r='4' fill='#c8b8ff'/>
  <!-- little smile face on the hood? keep simple: bumper -->
  <rect x='24' y='66' width='52' height='4' rx='2' fill='#b8241f'/>
</svg>
